English.Char_Desc_2000:
Photo Stitcher joins overlapping photos into one big picture, a panorama, the way Microsoft's Image Composite Editor used to. Add photos or a whole folder, in any order: the program works out where each one goes, whether they sit side by side, top to bottom, or in rows and columns. Pick the kind of photos (taken by turning the camera, or flat things such as documents, maps and walls scanned or shot in parts) and click Stitch the photos. It finds the matching details, evens out the brightness between photos, hides the seams and trims the ragged black edges to a clean rectangle. Any photo that doesn't fit is named, with the reason. A clock shows the progress and Cancel stops at once. An optional Adjust window turns and straightens it, squares up a slanted view by dragging 4 corner dots, crops it and makes it smaller, saving a separate adjusted copy. Save as JPG, PNG or TIFF. Opens JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, WebP and iPhone HEIC photos. The original photos are never changed. Everything it needs is included.
Before you install: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Photo Stitcher is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Photo Stitcher is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
